_note_target_year: Simulation runs years 2024 through 2034 inclusive (11 output rows per cell). 'Year 10' is the eleventh row, calendar year 2034. Phase-2b's validator filters the CSV to year == target_year and computes the metrics below.

height_year10._metric: Mean (across all cells) of meanHeight column at year == target_year.

occupancy_year10._metric: Mean tree count per cell at year == target_year.
